scope: Proposition 9.2 (The discrete residue quotient) of the manuscript “Finite generation for the K(n)-local sphere” (preprints/Finite-generation-for-the-Kn-local-sphere-September-24-2026/Finite-generation-for-the-Kn-local-sphere-September-24-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 313 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 07b43c6077268638), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 73. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The finite-level pairings extend uniquely to an exact sequence of k[G]-modules 0 −→ W+ −→ W π − − → Q −→ 0. (9.10) The map π is continuous on every complete coefficient step into the discrete countable module Q, including on compact parameter families. It is equivariant for the actual group actions on the support and compact-dual models. All these assertions allow arbitrary root denominators in W.
